title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30424: add prepayment update event
summary: A handled integration event was added to allow extensions to control prepayment amount updates when correcting posted sales invoices.
key_points: New `UpdateSalesOrderLinePrepmtAmount` event fires before prepayment amounts are updated
Subscribers can mark the event as handled to prevent standard prepayment updates
Event added across W1, APAC, and ES layers in Correct Posted Sales Invoice codeunit
Provides extensibility for custom prepayment handling logic
Enables subscribers to skip automatic prepayment restoration
quote: Extensions need a supported way to prevent sales order prepayment amounts from being restored when correcting a posted sales invoice.
